page.content:
Imperial church of the patriarchate of Constantinople.

How Eastern Orthodox Church connects

  • Location: Hagia Sophia — Hagia Sophia was the patriarchal cathedral.
  • Location: Constantinople — The Ecumenical Patriarchate sat in Constantinople.

What is Eastern Orthodox Church?

The Eastern Orthodox Church, headed in the capital by the Ecumenical Patriarch, was the empire's ritual and political religion after the schism with Rome.

Key threads lead to Hagia Sophia and Constantinople.
